concept.zh: 相邻合并的最低总能耗
concept.en: Least total energy for adjacent merges

brief.zh: weights 是按传送带顺序排放的箱重。每次只可合并两个相邻的箱子，耗电等于两箱重量之和，新箱仍在原处。把整排合为一箱的总耗电最少是多少？返回该数。零箱或一箱返回 0。
brief.en: weights gives the box weights in conveyor order. Merge only two adjacent boxes at a time. Each merge costs their combined weight and leaves that weight in their place. Return the least total energy to produce one box. Zero or one box costs 0.

label.en: Choose groups for the last merge

label.zh: 编号箱组并记录累计重量
label.en: Index groups and measure cumulative weight
